common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fantasy action-game combat status UI icon, square raster PNG, real transparent background. Make ONE compact original hand-painted synthetic-occult badge matching an aged-brass, charcoal and parchment game interface. A simple dark charcoal square inset with clipped bevelled corners and a restrained thin antique-brass rim; transparent outside the badge, no surrounding opaque square. Centered badge occupies about 86% of canvas width with clear transparent margins. The central symbol fills most of the inset and must read at 16-24 screen pixels: bold clean silhouette, a few broad painted material planes, bright controlled edges, large negative gaps, no fine engraving, no tiny particles. Flat front view, centered, no perspective. Not a sprite sheet or concept board. No letters, numbers, words, runes resembling text, captions, logos, characters, environment, checkerboard, broad bloom or cast shadows outside the badge.

asset_prompts.armoured: Central symbol: one substantial steel-blue breastplate, with two angular shoulder corners and one bold pale silver ridge. Clearly protective armour. Cool blue-gray body, pale steel edge lights, dark internal separation; keep the subject simple and solid.
asset_prompts.vampiric: Central symbol: a large vivid crimson blood drop between two short inward-curving ivory fangs. Strong red drop silhouette with one small pale red edge light; exactly two clear ivory fang shapes. Read as blood-draining vampirism, restrained and iconic, no realistic gore.
asset_prompts.shielded: Central symbol: one bright cyan hexagonal shield with a strong point at its top and bottom and just three broad faceted planes. Pale blue-white outer edge, clear cyan core. Compact solid protective shield, not a thin large ward ring.
asset_prompts.splitting: Central symbol: one vivid lime-green crystalline body fractured into two main halves and one smaller shard, separated by a broad dark jagged split. Bold angular green silhouette and a single strong diagonal fracture; recognizable division, no lightning cloud.
asset_prompts.fast: Central symbol: three substantial pale-yellow forward chevrons pointing RIGHT with one short swept wind stroke extending LEFT. Large separate arrowheads with clear dark gaps, pale gold face planes and ivory-yellow edge lights, compact speed glyph.
